description: Log in to Venmo with your username/email/phone and password. Required before all other operations. Optionally reads VENMO_USERNAME and VENMO_PASSWORD from environment variables.

password.description: Venmo account password. Falls back to VENMO_PASSWORD env var.

username.description: Venmo username, email, or phone number. Falls back to VENMO_USERNAME env var.

name: venmo_login
